items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: (To the question) When the GAR come into the Partzuf, the NH are separated, for the Netzach is then discerned as the carrier of the illumination of Hochma, and the Hod is discerned as the carrier of the screens, as above in Answer 196. And the aspect of the GAR is called the face; it is thus found that the NH are separated in the aspect of the face. Not so from the aspect of the posterior, namely as long as they have no GAR and no aspect of face, the NH are one, for there is no difference of aspect between them, as above, see there. (Part 1, Page 724, s.v. therefore).
